## Affected documentation

Link the page / heading and say which release or commit you used.

## Missing or incorrect information

Describe what is unclear. If a command failed, include the host / Android environment and redacted error.

## Suggested correction

Provide corrected wording or the steps you expected to find. Keep native and legacy behavior distinct and omit private device data.
